description: This script generates C++ header and source files mapping OpenGL enum values to strings for the ANGLE project. It reads XML files describing OpenGL enums and produces auto-generated code for enum-string mappings.

methods.name: dump_value_to_string_mapping
methods.description: Creates a string mapping of GLenum values to their string representations, filtering and sorting enum pairs.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that reads XML enum data, filters enums, and writes generated header and source files.
